# Common year starting on Saturday
The most recent year of such kind was [2022](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2022), and the next one will be [2033](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2033) in the Gregorian calendar[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Common_year_starting_on_Saturday#cite_note-math-1) or, likewise, [2023](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2023) and [2034](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2034) in the obsolete [Julian calendar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Julian_calendar).
